runs.name: KBR, Inc.; NYSE KBR, SEC CIK 0001357615; science, technology, engineering and logistics support to the U.S. federal government, allied nations and commercial clients in two segments, Mission Technology Solutions and Sustainable Technology Solutions; LinQuest bought 2024, Infrastar 2025; the spin-off of Mission Technology Solutions announced September 2025 and targeted for 2027-01-04; the 10-K names no rival, Leidos, CACI and Booz Allen read as a CONVENTION of the run
runs.entry: Price **$36.38** a share (2026-10-16, `tools/run.py` live quote; aggregator, flagged). Shares **126,067,755** common, one class (10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-07-03 cover, `0001357615-26-000172`; 183,154,727 issued less 57,086,972 treasury, the same). Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury 30-year par yield, 2026-10-15). Documents read: 10-K FY2025 (`0001357615-26-000051`), 10-Ks FY2023 and FY2021, the 10-Q of 2026-07-03 with Note 18 on the planned spin-off, the proxy filed 2026-03-30 (pay metrics only), 8-Ks of 2026-07-10, 2026-07-30, 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-16. The brief's two stated departures: lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7 (which part decides, how contracts are won and kept, contract mix and margins, acquisitions, goodwill, debt and receivables sold, the planned spin-off, legal and government matters), and the competitors the 10-K names; it names none, so Leidos, CACI and Booz Allen were read as a CONVENTION of the run. **Q1 IN**: Mission Technology Solutions sells staff time mainly on cost-reimbursable government contracts, little capital, segment margins 5.0% to 8.3%; the filer's "rapidly changing technology" and classified-contract opacity recorded against. **Q2 OUT**: the deciding part Mission Technology Solutions, 61% of five-year segment operating profit (1,989 of 3,242; on the three recast years Sustainable Technology Solutions carries 52%, the sensitivity written down); the filer's own 10-K: contracts "must be recompeted" "representing opportunities for competitors to take market share away from us", procurement that "sometimes emphasize[s] price over qualitative factors", termination "at any time for convenience" exercised against HomeSafe, "unexpectedly terminated" in 2025, the government's "own capabilities" a rival; the customer defines, audits and can definitize costs; Leidos, CACI and Booz Allen ten-year operating margins about 4% to 12%, co-moving, KBR's rising with the field. Q3 to Q12 not reached. **COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE**: owner cash FY2021 to FY2025 $236M, $304M, $231M, $363M, $449M, mean $316.6M equity-only, $391.0M all-equity, rebuilt from the filed statements (`tools/run.py` mixed continuing and total operating cash and found no stock pay); net acquisitions $1,123M, 71% of owner cash, a serial acquirer, central case without purchases; total revenue growth 1.49% as the organic upper bound, a CONVENTION of the run; net debt $2,200M; value range **$39.67 to $46.88** a share all-equity ($46.25 to $52.09 equity-only) against $36.38, no case earns the floor (5.8% to 6.5% all-equity, best single year 9.1%); fair **$15.21 all-equity** ($26.45 equity-only); not armed, the box is OUT at Q2. Balance sheets 2018 to mid-2026: goodwill and intangibles up $1.6B with equity flat ($1,718M to $1,636M), debt $1,248M to $2,552M, tangible equity about nil to minus $1.7B to $1.9B, buybacks ahead of retained earnings, receivables sold without recourse about $2.1B to $3.1B a year. Facts after the stop, recorded not judged: about $10.6B of awards under protest, Mission Technology Solutions revenue down 4% in the first half of 2026, adjusted figures and reaffirmed guidance in the July 2026 release, the 2023 qui tam settlement ($109M, liability denied), the July 2026 severance amendments (multiple 1.0x to 1.5x, missed targets no longer Cause). Contamination declared by the analyst: the ACM commit subjects, one listing of `Test Runs/` filtered to the date printing other file names (not contents) and the memory index lines; none used. Commits a8ba8d28 (Step 0 and Q1), f2018f38 (Q2), 0587fe1c (computation, box, close). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_run.py` 29 distinct ids, PASS; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` 43 id occurrences, no missing id, no E-id, one flag verified as the checker reading the neighbouring id's quote (L2014-005): **no slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) which segment basis governs the parts threshold when the filer recasts inside the window; (2) no fallback for organic growth a serial acquirer does not report; (3) no rule for a pending spin-off that changes what the buyer owns; (4) whether a discontinued part's cash losses count in owner cash; (5) cash tax below book tax for causes other than carryforwards; (6) `tools/run.py` mixing continuing and total operating cash and missing stock pay; (7) a range above the price while no case earns the floor, readable as cheap by a reader of the range alone. Could not get: a reported organic growth rate, the year-end balance of receivables sold, the size of the FY2025 change-order resolution, the cause of cash tax below book tax.
runs.narr: OUT at Q2 after Q1 IN (KBR; government science, engineering and logistics services in Mission Technology Solutions, process technology and engineering in Sustainable Technology Solutions; the spin-off of Mission Technology Solutions targeted for 2027-01-04). The castle of the deciding part, Mission Technology Solutions at 61% of five-year segment profit, shown open on the filer's own 10-K: recompetes "representing opportunities for competitors to take market share away from us", procurement that "sometimes emphasize[s] price over qualitative factors", termination for convenience exercised against HomeSafe, the government's own capabilities a rival; Leidos, CACI and Booz Allen margins close and co-moving. Computation beneath the stop: value $39.67 to $46.88 all-equity against $36.38, no case earns the floor, fair $15.21 ($26.45 equity-only), not armed. Facts recorded, not judged: debt doubled and tangible equity negative after acquisitions, about $10.6B of awards under protest, the 2023 qui tam settlement, severance amended in July 2026. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: the parts threshold across a segment recast, organic growth a serial acquirer does not report, a pending spin-off, discontinued cash losses, cash tax below book, `tools/run.py` missing stock pay.
